Container.Name: plex-exporter
Container.Overview:
See what your Plex server is doing in Grafana: sessions, libraries, bandwidth, transcoding.
Connects to your Plex Media Server and exposes metrics (active sessions, library sizes, bandwidth, transcoding status) on /metrics for Prometheus to scrape and Grafana to visualize. A ready-made Grafana dashboard ships in the project repository (grafana-dashboard.json). Read-only against Plex, no web UI of its own.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: plex prometheus grafana metrics exporter monitoring
Container.Requires: Needs a Prometheus-compatible scraper (Prometheus, Grafana Alloy, VictoriaMetrics) pointed at port 9594 and Grafana to show the dashboard; neither is included. Plex URL: the full URL of your Plex server including scheme and port, for example http://192.0.2.100:32400. Plex Token: the server administrator's token, from Plex Web: Settings, then the XML view of any item, then myPlexAccessToken. Host CPU, memory and bandwidth metrics require Plex Pass; everything else works without it. The metrics endpoint has no authentication: keep port 9594 on your LAN.

Config.Name: Plex URL
Config.Description: Full URL of your Plex Media Server including scheme and port, e.g. http://192.0.2.100:32400

Config.Name: Plex Token
Config.Description: Plex authentication token of the server administrator (Plex Web: Settings, XML view, myPlexAccessToken)

Config.Name: Plex CA certificate path
Config.Description: Only for an https Plex URL with a self-signed or private-CA certificate: in-container path of the CA PEM file (add a matching path mapping)
